versions.content: Every Service Discovery Configuration Instance (see configuration container SdInstance) shall have at least one TxPdu ID, one RxPdu ID for Unicast, and one RxPdu ID for Multicast (see configuration parameter SdInstanceTxPdu, Sd InstanceUnicastRxPdu, and SdInstanceMulticastRxPdu respectively).
